environment.description: Actix-web OAuth service deployed as a container on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with a public-facing listener on port 443. The ALB forwards all traffic to the target group on port 8080. No additional request filtering or authentication is configured at the infrastructure level. The service is accessible to any internet client.

config.load_balancer: ALB with public listener, no WAF attached
config.network: Public subnets, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
config.auth: None - application handles its own OAuth flow
